nodes.label: CASH approval chain (SUP to ACC)
nodes.rationale: Net-new cash customer requires finance-tier sign-off but not the full credit tier; Salesman to Supervisor to Accountant is the minimal chain.

nodes.label: CREDIT approval chain (SUP to FM to GM to ACC)
nodes.rationale: GM is ALWAYS required for credit with no credit-limit threshold that skips GM (R3); org-wide FM and GM approve or reject the exact requested figures without amending them.
nodes.norm_label: credit approval chain (sup to fm to gm to acc)

nodes.label: CREATE process (net-new customer)
nodes.rationale: customerId is null until finalize; nothing touches the live master until the final Accountant step materializes Customer + Branch[] all-or-nothing.

nodes.label: UPDATE process (enrichment/correction)
nodes.rationale: Single-step Supervisor approval with region-Manager fallback; Viewer is read-only.

nodes.label: Step-aware approval engine
nodes.rationale: Config-in-code chain matrix resolved once at submit and frozen as JSON so in-flight requests stay deterministic even if the matrix later changes.

nodes.label: Step-back reject cascade
nodes.rationale: A rejection returns the request to the previous approver; a first-step rejection returns to the salesman as NEEDS_CORRECTION.

nodes.label: Approval loop guard
nodes.rationale: Prevents infinite ping-pong: a step that rejects the same request twice in one cycle sends it straight to the salesman.

nodes.label: Separation of duty
nodes.rationale: Submitter can never approve and no user may act on two different steps of the same request (enforced per-cycle via priorStepActorIds).

nodes.label: Atomic-claim concurrency
nodes.rationale: Each transition is an updateMany guarded on {id,state,currentStepIndex,cycle}; two racing approvers, only one wins, no double-apply.

nodes.label: Optimistic locking (version field)
nodes.rationale: version on Customer/Branch protects a direct write racing an approval; reactivation/close paths were found to bypass it (C10).

nodes.label: Duplicate hard-block (CR + name/phone/region)
nodes.rationale: Exact-CR and name+phone+region duplicates hard-blocked under advisory locks on the CREATE-finalize path; import/edit paths have no DB-level CR uniqueness backstop (C17).

nodes.label: Fail-closed region/route scope
nodes.rationale: An unscoped Manager/Accountant sees nothing, never everything; enforced by customerListBranchScope and loadScope.

nodes.label: SLA working-hours calendar
nodes.rationale: Asia/Muscat UTC+4 no DST, 08-17, working-minutes only; fixes the OLD system's confirmed timezone bug via a fixed UTC+4 shift and closed-form deadline math.

nodes.label: Temix outbound batch sync (CRM to Temix)
nodes.rationale: Flip-first-then-snapshot design so no concurrent edit can be lost; batch Excel upload since there is no live Temix API in v1.
nodes.norm_label: temix outbound batch sync (crm to temix)

nodes.label: Temix inbound refresh
nodes.rationale: Rides the customer-master import with a temix_code column; applies Temix-authoritative fields without clobbering CRM-owned data and rejects crosswalk conflicts for Steward review.

nodes.label: Duplicate merge
nodes.rationale: Sorted FOR UPDATE lock + in-tx liveness recheck + 20s tx timeout so a concurrent reversed-pair merge cannot archive both customers (PROD-DUP-01).

nodes.label: Temix ERP
nodes.rationale: System of record for transactions and the definitive customer code; the CRM aids it via batch Excel uploads, it does not replace it.

nodes.label: Adversarial multi-agent review + independent refutation
nodes.rationale: N hostile finder lenses find defects grounded in file:line, then each HIGH/CRITICAL finding is handed to 2-3 independent refuters (2/3 to confirm); only majority-survivors are treated as real.

nodes.label: Deep scan round 2
nodes.rationale: Workflow wf_aa0006af-294 · 7 finders × 3-lens verify + completeness & regression critics · 63 agents; 16 confirmed, 2 refuted; regression critic cleared the 3 prior P1 fixes.

nodes.label: C20 — photo-gc hard-deletes Attachment row even when R2 tagging fails
nodes.rationale: P3 carried. On a transient R2 error the object is never tagged for lifecycle expiry yet the DB row+r2Key is deleted — an unbounded storage leak with the object left immortal and untracked. R2 write-path deferred (prod bucket).
nodes.norm_label: c20 — photo-gc hard-deletes attachment row even when r2 tagging fails

nodes.label: R2 [P1] Empty-scope Supervisor filtered export dumps any team's PII (mergeStringIn fail-open)
nodes.rationale: FIXED. mergeStringIn treats an existing empty {in:[]} branch-scope predicate as unconstrained (∅∩filter computed as filter), so a zero-team Supervisor adding a URL filter overrides the fail-closed empty scope and exports out-of-scope customer PII. The customers LIST page is unaffected (uses id='__none__'); only the filtered-export path passed the raw empty array.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p1] empty-scope supervisor filtered export dumps any team's pii (mergestringin fail-open)

nodes.label: R2 [P2] In-group branchCode collision silently overwrites a branch on promote
nodes.rationale: FIXED. Within one custCode group the promote loop never de-duplicates the resolved branchCode; a generated ordinal (custCode-NN) can equal an explicit composed code, and the same-customer collision passes the cross-customer steal guard, so the second row UPDATE-overwrites the first branch while both report PROMOTED. Regression of the F-P01 bare-code composition fix — now rejects the group to review.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p2] in-group branchcode collision silently overwrites a branch on promote

nodes.label: R2 [P2] Branch-code composition collides with generated positional codes
nodes.rationale: FIXED. The F-P01 fix composes a bare code into custCode-code, sharing the namespace of formatBranchCode(custCode,position); a mix of an explicit bare '03' and codeless rows collapses two branches into one. The fix widened the collision surface from pre-composed to bare codes.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p2] branch-code composition collides with generated positional codes

nodes.label: R2 [P2] Account-master Users import reports wrong spreadsheet row numbers after role-sort
nodes.rationale: FIXED. Users sheet is re-sorted by role into sortedRows for dependency ordering but issue messages report i+2 on the SORTED index, so every quarantine points the Steward at the wrong physical line (Regions/Routes iterate unsorted and are correct).
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p2] account-master users import reports wrong spreadsheet row numbers after role-sort

nodes.label: R2 [P2] Cross-region merge is a permanent dead-end — MergeForm never sends confirmCrossRegion/reason
nodes.rationale: FIXED. CR-number duplicate detection is region-agnostic so cross-region pairs surface on /duplicates, but mergeCustomersCore demands confirmCrossRegion=yes+reason and MergeForm has no field for either — the Steward is stuck on an unsatisfiable error and cross-region duplicates could never be resolved.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p2] cross-region merge is a permanent dead-end — mergeform never sends confirmcrossregion/reason

nodes.label: R2 [P2] Password reset via account import does not revoke existing sessions
nodes.rationale: FIXED. The import reset rotates passwordHash but never bumps sessionsRevokedAt (the sole session-kill marker) nor sets mustChangePassword, so an attacker's JWT survives up to the 8h TTL — unlike the in-app reset. Now revokes sessions.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p2] password reset via account import does not revoke existing sessions

nodes.label: R2 [P3] Account re-import silently unlinks a user's supervisor/route on a blank column
nodes.rationale: FIXED. update unconditionally disconnects supervisor/ownedRoute when the cell is blank (unlike password/role which are presence-protected), with no audit; a partial re-import severs approval routing (resolveStepAudience/canApproveSpecificEdit fail on null supervisorId). Now keeps the link on blank.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p3] account re-import silently unlinks a user's supervisor/route on a blank column

nodes.label: R2 [P3] Customer-master promote never computes completenessScore (all imported at 0)
nodes.rationale: FIXED. Promote upserts customers/branches but never calls scoreCustomer/scoreBranch, so the stored completenessScore stays 0 (schema default) and drives min/maxScore filters, exports, and dashboards to 0% until each row is individually edited. Now computes the score.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p3] customer-master promote never computes completenessscore (all imported at 0)

nodes.label: R2 [P3] Promote batch detail page never revalidated — stale READY view + live Promote button
nodes.rationale: FIXED. promoteCustomerBatchAction revalidates only /import (list) not the /import/[batchId] detail route and PromoteButton does no router.refresh, so after a successful promote the detail page keeps showing READY + the Promote button; the F-07 atomic claim prevents corruption but the stale UI invites a confusing re-click.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p3] promote batch detail page never revalidated — stale ready view + live promote button

nodes.label: R2 [P3] F-P02 fallback silently discards a valid region when a branch row has region but no route
nodes.rationale: FIXED. The F-P02 rewrite resolves region strictly from the route; a valid regionCode with an absent routeCode falls to the UNASSIGNED pair with no warning (groupResolveErrors stays empty), trading the old loud B-19 abort for a silent region downgrade with no audit flag.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p3] f-p02 fallback silently discards a valid region when a branch row has region but no route

nodes.label: R2 [P3] CustomerEdit_open_per_customer index collides reactivation/close with enrichment edits
nodes.rationale: Carried. The partial unique index covers ALL SUBMITTED CustomerEdit rows with a non-null customerId, so a customer can have at most one open edit of any type; reactivation/close paths create without translating P2002, surfacing a misleading generic 'refresh and try again' that no refresh fixes.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p3] customeredit_open_per_customer index collides reactivation/close with enrichment edits

nodes.label: R2 [P3] Merge leaves moved CR photo's Attachment.customerId pointing at the archived loser
nodes.rationale: Carried. Moving the loser's crPhotoId onto the winner never updates the Attachment's own customerId; a later detachPhotoCore keys the slot-clear on att.customerId (the loser), matches 0 rows, and leaves winner.crPhotoId dangling — over-counting completeness by +10 until the 30-day GC self-heals it.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p3] merge leaves moved cr photo's attachment.customerid pointing at the archived loser

nodes.label: R2 [P3] Reactivation review shows old shop/signboard photos, never the mandatory fresh evidence
nodes.rationale: Carried. QA-008 stores the fresh reactivation evidence as a FREE attachment in edit.attachmentChanges (not branch.shopPhotoId/signboardPhotoId), but the Manager's review page renders the branch's PRE-existing photos and never reads attachmentChanges — so for import-born customers with no branch photos the review shows ZERO evidence.
nodes.norm_label: r2 [p3] reactivation review shows old shop/signboard photos, never the mandatory fresh evidence

nodes.label: Pre-launch deep review (round 1)
nodes.rationale: Workflow wf_6368e12e-247 · 7 finders × 3-lens adversarial verify (2/3 majority) + completeness critic · 95 agents; 25 confirmed, 4 refuted.

nodes.label: CREDIT create approval chain
nodes.rationale: CREDIT create chain is SUPERVISOR→FINANCE_MANAGER→GM→ACCOUNTANT; FM/GM are GLOBAL org-wide approvers; GM always present. Separation of duty prevents one party walking a fraudulent high-credit customer through every step.

nodes.label: B-05 optimistic version lock
nodes.rationale: Customer.version must increment on every write so a concurrent edit-approve sees VERSION_CONFLICT rather than a silent revert; applyEditChanges' version-equality updateMany is the only cross-writer conflict detector.

nodes.label: Temix refresh lane
nodes.rationale: Presence-aware refresh lane: keeps CRM-owned identity/contact untouched, treats credit figures as Temix-authoritative, preserves absent payment_terms, and increments version for B-05. Selected per-row by isRefresh = existing && !deleted && !!temixCode.

nodes.label: Legacy full-upsert lane
nodes.rationale: Non-refresh lane (rows without temix_code) overwrites CRM-enriched fields, defaults absent payment_terms to CASH, does not bump version and does not touch temixSyncState — the destructive twin of the refresh lane.

nodes.label: C22 — xlsx decompression bomb / unbounded parse memory
nodes.rationale: Completeness-critic gap. The 5MB cap bounds compressed size only; exceljs inflates the whole workbook in memory with no row/sheet cap — a well-under-5MB file OOMs the 30s function. Planned check that fell through the cracks (never dispositioned). Fix: reject workbooks above a hard row/sheet budget or stream with early-abort.
nodes.norm_label: c22 — xlsx decompression bomb / unbounded parse memory

nodes.label: R1-#1 [P1] Manager can create/take over/disable org-wide credit approvers
nodes.rationale: canMutateUser only protects MANAGER/STEWARD tiers; ACCOUNTANT/FINANCE_MANAGER/GM fall through to ok:true, defeating credit-chain separation of duty. Fixed + regression-proven (user-admin-authz.test.ts).
nodes.norm_label: r1-#1 [p1] manager can create/take over/disable org-wide credit approvers

nodes.label: R1-#2 [P1] Empty-region Manager reads nationwide customer master on /customers (SR-M2 sibling)
nodes.rationale: Empty managedRegions leaves branchSomeBase undefined so the where collapses to {deletedAt:null}; the list page failed OPEN while every other surface fail-closes with id='__none__'. Fixed via shared fail-closed helper (customer-list-scope.test.ts).
nodes.norm_label: r1-#2 [p1] empty-region manager reads nationwide customer master on /customers (sr-m2 sibling)

nodes.label: R1-#3 [P1] Merge never claims/re-validates the WINNER — reversed-pair concurrent merges
nodes.rationale: PROD-001 atomic claim applied only to the loser; two stewards with opposite winner choices both commit, soft-deleting BOTH customers and stranding live branches under deleted parents + double DEACTIVATE to Temix. Fixed + regression-proven (merge-concurrency.test.ts).
nodes.norm_label: r1-#3 [p1] merge never claims/re-validates the winner — reversed-pair concurrent merges

nodes.label: R1-#4/#8 [P2] Promote has no crash/timeout recovery — batch stranded in PROMOTING forever
nodes.rationale: READY→PROMOTING claim has no lease/expiry/requeue; the sole PROMOTING→PROMOTED write is after the whole per-group loop, so a 30s kill mid-loop strands the batch permanently with no code path back to READY. Pairs with the chunked-import task (RK-3).
nodes.norm_label: r1-#4/#8 [p2] promote has no crash/timeout recovery — batch stranded in promoting forever

nodes.label: R1-#5 [P2] attachPhoto/detachPhoto TOCTOU — dangling photo-slot pointers the GC then destroys
nodes.rationale: Wiring state checked pre-tx and written unguarded; create-finalize.ts bindOne and creates.ts have the guarded-updateMany TOCTOU fix but photos.ts got neither — dangling pointer passes evidence gates while photo-gc destroys the R2 bytes.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#5 [p2] attachphoto/detachphoto toctou — dangling photo-slot pointers the gc then destroys

nodes.label: R1-#6 / R2-carried [P2] In-file dup phone/CR check not keyed by cust_code
nodes.rationale: phonesInFile/crsInFile keyed only by value; one-row-per-branch masters repeat customer-level phone/CR so every multi-branch customer is fully quarantined with no requeue. Master-side check was fixed (keyed by owning nmwcCode) but the in-file check was not. Carried.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#6 / r2-carried [p2] in-file dup phone/cr check not keyed by cust_code

nodes.label: R1-#7 [P2] Legacy re-import overwrites CRM-enriched fields, resets absent payment_terms to CASH
nodes.rationale: Non-refresh lane (no temix_code) clobbers legalName/paymentTerms/phone/contact/CR without version bump or audit, flipping blank-payment_terms CREDIT customers to CASH — and re-upload is the only recovery path for quarantined rows.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#7 [p2] legacy re-import overwrites crm-enriched fields, resets absent payment_terms to cash

nodes.label: R1-#9 [P2] Archiving corrected crosswalk-less migrated customer drops Temix deactivation (parks SYNCED)
nodes.rationale: resolveArchiveTemixState's knownToTemix signal is destroyed by any approved correction (SYNCED→PENDING_UPLOAD) for a migrated customer with null temixCode/lastTemixUploadAt; the archive parks SYNCED and no DEACTIVATE is queued — Temix keeps the customer active forever.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#9 [p2] archiving corrected crosswalk-less migrated customer drops temix deactivation (parks synced)

nodes.label: R1-#10 [P2] Outbound UPSERT pushes stale Temix-authoritative credit fields back into the ERP
nodes.rationale: buildTemixRows emits payment_terms/credit_limit/payment_term_days on every UPSERT and any unrelated approved correction requeues the whole customer, re-pushing the CRM's last-refresh snapshot over Temix. Owner decision D2 later confirmed the outbound push is intended (refutes this finding).
nodes.norm_label: r1-#10 [p2] outbound upsert pushes stale temix-authoritative credit fields back into the erp

nodes.label: R1-#11 [P2] No per-row ERP outcome tracking — rejected row stuck in UPLOADED; false SYNCED settle
nodes.rationale: TemixSyncBatch records no per-row accepted/rejected outcome and no UPLOADED→PENDING_UPLOAD requeue exists; rejected creates sit in UPLOADED forever while any later extract falsely settles corrections to SYNCED. Owner design call (per-row tracking?).
nodes.norm_label: r1-#11 [p2] no per-row erp outcome tracking — rejected row stuck in uploaded; false synced settle

nodes.label: R1-#12 [P2] Refresh-lane routing keys on per-row temix_code presence — header mismatch reroutes to legacy clobber
nodes.rationale: isRefresh = existing && !deleted && !!temixCode with no steward-chosen mode; a renamed/blank code column sends rows into the legacy full-clobber lane (CRM enrichment reverted, CREDIT→CASH, no version bump, temixSyncState untouched). Real Temix header row unconfirmed (Q-temix-headers / D4).
nodes.norm_label: r1-#12 [p2] refresh-lane routing keys on per-row temix_code presence — header mismatch reroutes to legacy clobber

nodes.label: R1-#13 [P2] No automated prisma migrate deploy in the deploy path — first Phase-1 deploy outage
nodes.rationale: build is prisma generate && next build with no migrate step; Vercel auto-deploys on push so new code serves against the old schema (P2022/42703 app-wide outage). Health probe stays green (no DB probe). TECH-SPEC and OPERATIONS docs contradict each other. Migrate-deploy later added to the pipeline.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#13 [p2] no automated prisma migrate deploy in the deploy path — first phase-1 deploy outage

nodes.label: R1-#14 [P2] Vercel fra1 vs Neon us-east-1 — transatlantic RTT times out sequential import loops
nodes.rationale: Functions pinned to fra1 while the DB is us-east-1 (~85-95ms RTT); per-row sequential findUnique loops in promote make the import 504 at production scale. Fixed by co-location (config, this round).
nodes.norm_label: r1-#14 [p2] vercel fra1 vs neon us-east-1 — transatlantic rtt times out sequential import loops

nodes.label: R1-#15 [P2] CRON_SECRET/HEALTH_BEARER/DEMO_ACCOUNTS_DISABLED read by prod code but absent from docs
nodes.rationale: Missing from .env.example/OPERATIONS: unset CRON_SECRET fails closed (all crons 401 → photo-GC/SLA dead), no HEALTH_BEARER blinds monitoring, unset DEMO_ACCOUNTS_DISABLED leaves seeded demo logins live. Now documented in .env.example.

nodes.rationale: Queue/detail pages authorize on the FROZEN draft region while approveEditCore authorizes on the route's CURRENT region; a Steward import re-regioning the route makes the request undecidable through the UI with no Steward/Manager override. Tracked as RK-2 frozen-chain-vs-current-role drift.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#16 [p2] create request wedges at accountant step when route is re-regioned mid-chain (rk-2)

nodes.label: R1-#17 [P2] Close-shop un-approvable on incomplete import-born customers (EL-04 re-check)
nodes.rationale: approveEditCore runs the EL-04 whole-customer mandatory-field gate for any SALESMAN submitter with no exemption for status-only close-shop edits; import-born customers have no photos so the Supervisor gets NEEDS_REUPLOAD and closures can never clear the designed lane.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#17 [p2] close-shop un-approvable on incomplete import-born customers (el-04 re-check)

nodes.label: R1-#18/#24 [P3] Legacy import upsert writes master fields outside the B-05 version protocol
nodes.rationale: Non-refresh lane updates existing customers without version increment; the refresh lane and archive/merge got the B-05 bump but this twin was left out, so a concurrent edit-approve last-write-wins with no VERSION_CONFLICT.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#18/#24 [p3] legacy import upsert writes master fields outside the b-05 version protocol

nodes.label: R1-#19 [P3] First crosswalk-backfill refresh floods the Steward with one TEMIX_SYNC_ACKED per customer
nodes.rationale: TEMIX_SYNC_ACKED fires per refresh row that lands a temix_code, addressed to createdById (the importing Steward for master-created customers); notifyUsers dedupes only within one call, so a first backfill writes thousands of notifications to one bell.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#19 [p3] first crosswalk-backfill refresh floods the steward with one temix_sync_acked per customer

nodes.label: R1-#20/#23 [P3] Cutover backfill leaves pre-Phase-1 SUBMITTED edits with slaDueAt NULL
nodes.rationale: Migration backfills approvalChain/pendingRole/stageEnteredAt but never computes slaDueAt; level-1 sweep filters slaDueAt<now (excludes NULL) and the queue orders by slaDueAt asc NULLS LAST — the oldest cutover work is permanently SLA-exempt and sinks to the bottom. Fix: one-off post-deploy slaDueAt backfill.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#20/#23 [p3] cutover backfill leaves pre-phase-1 submitted edits with sladueat null

nodes.label: R1-#21 [P3] SLA sweep worst case exceeds 30s maxDuration — truncated sweeps + red cron runs
nodes.rationale: Up to 400 sequential per-row interactive transactions + per-steward advisory-lock loop + GC can be 20-60s over Neon; Vercel kills mid-sweep (self-healing next tick) but the steward ping/GC starve and the GH Actions curl -f marks the run failed during a breach storm.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#21 [p3] sla sweep worst case exceeds 30s maxduration — truncated sweeps + red cron runs

nodes.label: R1-#22 [P3] vercel.json maxDuration glob app/**/*.ts misses server actions under page.tsx
nodes.rationale: The *.ts glob matches route handlers but not page.tsx; heavy server actions (imports, temix batch build, exports) run under .tsx page entries at the platform default (10s Hobby), not the intended 30s.
nodes.norm_label: r1-#22 [p3] vercel.json maxduration glob app/**/*.ts misses server actions under page.tsx

nodes.label: R1-#25 [P3] Phase-1 backfill stamps pre-existing reactivations pendingRole=SUPERVISOR (un-actionable rows)
nodes.rationale: Backfill lacks an isReactivation=false predicate so pre-Phase-1 reactivation requests get a frozen SUPERVISOR chain; they enter Supervisor/Manager queues but the QA-C11 WRONG_LANE guard errors on every decision attempt — decidable only by a Manager from /reactivations.

nodes.label: Final-hunt #1 — EL-04 re-check blocks all branch-close approvals for imported customers

nodes.label: Final-hunt #2 — In-file phone/CR dup not scoped by cust_code (F-UAT-7)
nodes.rationale: In-file phone/CR duplicate detectors keyed only on the value, so a multi-branch customer repeating its own phone/CR across branch rows quarantined itself; fix flags an in-file dup only across a different cust_code (already fixed pre-hunt in commit 382e9c5).

nodes.label: Final-hunt #3 — paymentTerms CASH/CREDIT flip via UPDATE bypasses credit chain
nodes.rationale: An ordinary UPDATE (single Supervisor step) could flip Customer.paymentTerms CASH<->CREDIT with no transition guard, bypassing the owner-locked SUP->FM->GM->ACC credit chain and pushing a corrupted credit record to Temix; fix rejects any paymentTerms change in the edit flow.
nodes.norm_label: final-hunt #3 — paymentterms cash/credit flip via update bypasses credit chain

nodes.label: Final-hunt #4 — Non-refresh re-import full-overwrites CRM-owned fields
nodes.rationale: The non-refresh upsert UPDATE unconditionally overwrote paymentTerms (default CASH), primaryPhone/contactPerson/crNumber/legalName for existing customers; the presence-aware guard was wired only into the Temix refresh lane. nodes.label: Final-hunt #5 — Temix refresh degrades to destructive full-upsert on header mismatch
nodes.rationale: isRefresh hinges on parsing temix_code via four hard-coded header fallbacks; an unmatched Temix code column parses temixCode=null, routing every row to the plain upsert that NULLs CRM-owned phone/CR/contact and bypasses all crosswalk guards nested under if(first.temixCode). Fixed with the #4 presence-aware cluster.
nodes.norm_label: final-hunt #5 — temix refresh degrades to destructive full-upsert on header mismatch

nodes.label: Final-hunt #6 — Re-import silently downgrades CREDIT to CASH (F-12 asymmetric)
nodes.rationale: The F-12 paymentTermsPresent fix was applied only to the refresh branch; the non-refresh full-upsert still writes paymentTerms=CASH when the column is absent, flipping an existing CREDIT customer to CASH and orphaning creditLimit/paymentTermDays. Fixed with the #4 presence-aware cluster (commit b0f70b2).
nodes.norm_label: final-hunt #6 — re-import silently downgrades credit to cash (f-12 asymmetric)

nodes.label: Final-hunt #7 — CREATE approval scope drift (frozen draft vs current route region, RK-2)
nodes.rationale: Queue/detail authorize CREATE requests on the frozen EditBranchDraft.regionId while approve/reject/finalize authorize on the route's current region; a mid-chain route re-region strands the request at the Accountant step (visibility-vs-authorization wedge). Documented P2 follow-up.
nodes.norm_label: final-hunt #7 — create approval scope drift (frozen draft vs current route region, rk-2)

nodes.label: Final-hunt #8 — Branch 'Address pending' fallback unreachable, group REJECTED (B-20)
nodes.rationale: address ?? [branchName,regionCode].filter(Boolean).join(', ') ?? 'Address pending' — the middle operand is '' (not nullish) for all-blank rows, so the guard never fires; '' fails the B-20 length>=3 CHECK and the whole customer group is REJECTED. Fix switches ?? to ||.
nodes.norm_label: final-hunt #8 — branch 'address pending' fallback unreachable, group rejected (b-20)

nodes.label: Final-hunt #9 — paymentTermsPresent guard missing in non-refresh upsert lane
nodes.rationale: Duplicate of the CREDIT->CASH absent-column flip in the non-refresh lane; fixed with the #4 presence-aware cluster.

nodes.norm_label: final-hunt #10 — detachphoto never recomputes completenessscore (rollup drift)

nodes.label: Final-hunt #11 — photo-gc hard-deletes DB row on R2 tag failure (permanent orphan)
